Hello! I am Ryan Marangattu (I also go by Ryan Varghese), a data analyst at the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center in Los Angeles.

I support analytics and research in Cancer Control and Population Sciences, with work spanning REDCap survey setup, Excel data cleaning, literature searches, reporting, and research coordination. I hold a B.S. in Statistics from Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo.

## Analytics and research

- **Research data:** Organize and clean data in Excel to support analysis and reporting.
- **Survey workflows:** Set up REDCap surveys and support research documentation.
- **Research operations:** Coordinate meetings, search literature, and prepare reports for the research team.
- **Statistical computing:** Use Python, R, and SAS across academic projects and prior work.
